audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1-4 disagree with the packet chart, the whys[] prose and the already-audited mirror. Rows 1 and 2 read Yorick while whys[1]/whys[2] say the stage is even; rows 3 and 4 read Skill while whys[3]/whys[4] say Urgot is ahead.
audit.why: The mirror (urgot__yorick) set rows 1-2 to Skill and rows 3-4 to Urgot; packet levelChart agrees. Our side must state the same facts inverted, not contradict them.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 and 2 -> Skill, rows 3 and 4 -> Urgot, proposed as matched full/content pairs across the whole affected group. Prose already matched, so no whys edits needed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Urgot's level-6 spike was described without its cooldown or range, so the reader has no window to play around.
audit.why: Fear Beyond Death is 2500 range on 100/85/70s — that is the number that tells you how long you are safe after he misses.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now carries 2500 range and the 100/85/70s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text asserted 'the suppression can't be QSS'd out of once it locks'. Three do/don't bodies were generic filler under specific titles ('Dodge his E flip', 'Stand in his W shred', 'Get hit by his E').
audit.why: QSS/cleanse eligibility is not in Riot's text and the kit file's needsResearch is empty, which means unknown — it must not be asserted. Disdain is 475 range, 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s, shields him and hurls you behind him; Purge is 490 range and self-slows him.
audit.corrected: The QSS claim removed and replaced with verifiable range/cooldown; each do/don't body now states the mechanic its title promises.

edits.before: Fear the Fear Beyond Death (R): below the execute threshold Urgot flips and drags you in for a guaranteed kill, and the suppression can't be QSS'd out of once it locks. Keep your HP above the execute line and hold W Dark Procession to cage him off after he flips you.
edits.after: Fear the Fear Beyond Death (R): fired from 2500 range on a 100/85/70s cooldown, it impales you and, below the execute threshold, drags you in for a guaranteed kill. Keep your HP above that line, and hold Dark Procession (W) to wall him off after he flips you.

edits.before: Urgot wastes Disdain (Flip) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Disdain is 475 range on 16/15/14s — bait it, then commit the pattern.

edits.before: That is Urgot's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Purge self-slows him at 490 range — walk out of it and his whole DPS dies.

edits.before: Trading without ghouls or caging nothing — Yorick without the swarm is the worst duelist in the lane.
edits.after: Disdain shields him and hurls you behind — never stand between Urgot and his tower with no ghouls.

notes: The missing-interactions entry claims Dark Procession shuts off Corrosive Charge (Q) as a dash. Riot's own text says Q 'fires an explosive charge at the target location' — Urgot does not move with it, so the 'dash' derived flag misfired and I did NOT write that interaction. Disdain (E) is the charge, and that is what the cage lines address.
